Comment.Language: For the Feast of the Cross and the Commemoration of King Constantine and Queen Helen:

Text.Language: Hiten nieu,/ n~te Pa[oic p~ouro Kwnctantinoc nem ?~lan/ tefmau ]ourw: P~[oic arih~mot nan m~pi,w e~bol n~te nennobi.
Through the prayers of my lord the King Constantine and his mother Queen Helen: O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
بصلوات سيدي الملك قسطنطين وأمه الملكة هيلانة ياربُ أنعم علينا بمغفرة خطايانا.
